In a nightmare, Aylen sat on her best friend Sarah’s couch and tearfully described vivid nightmares and visions. Sarah comforted Aylen, but then spoke ominously, smirked, and revealed herself as the entity tormenting Aylen. The entity implied it could control Aylen’s mind and urged her, “You know what you have to do.” Aylen woke in bed drenched in sweat, heart pounding, and resolved to stop the entity.

The assistant interpreted the entity’s line “You know what you have to do” as manipulative and possibly urging Aylen toward a difficult decision, drastic action, or discovery; the line makes Aylen question her agency.

Aylen experienced a broad-daylight vision on a busy street in which a shifting figure taunted her, mocked her appearance, abilities, friends, family, and life, and told her to surrender her mind and body. When Aylen tried to flee, the entity vanished, leaving her frightened and shaking in the crowd.

In a revised vision, Aylen tried to fight the entity, but her hands passed through it as if it were a mirage. The amused entity repeatedly vanished and reappeared just out of reach, calling “Over here!” and taunting Aylen as she flailed and failed to hit it. The vision ended with Aylen feeling defeated and humiliated.

In a vision in a park, Aylen asked the shifting entity what it wanted and why it tormented her. It said it enjoyed watching her suffer, called her weak and easy to manipulate, and promised it would always be with her. Aylen tried to strike it, but could not touch it; it vanished, leaving her trembling with fear and anger.

Aylen confronted the entity in a deserted street, asking why it intended to destroy the world and why it made her watch terrible events. The entity said it enjoyed watching the world burn and mortals suffer, and described Aylen as a convenient tool to show it the way. Aylen said she would not be used and tried to attack, but could not touch it. After it vanished, Aylen felt trapped and believed she could not stop it.

Aylen developed a test, described as similar to the reality checks in Inception, to determine whether she was in the real world. The next time Aylen confided in Sarah, she performed the test first; it worked and confirmed that she was in reality. Aylen then poured out her fears and described her visions. Sarah listened, reassured Aylen that she believed her, and offered to help stop the entity from destroying the world. Aylen felt relieved to have a trusted ally.
records.topic: reality test and confiding in Sarah
